svg.title: Multi-agent AI application — LangGraph architecture
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture: chat UI, FastAPI server, LangGraph state graph with classifier node and router node, FastMCP agent registry, four specialized agents, and shared MCP tool layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should the chat UI stream tokens from a LangGraph agent over WebSockets?')
sendPrompt('How does FastAPI integrate with LangGraph for streaming graph execution over WebSockets?')

svg.text: LangGraph state graph · shared AgentState: { messages, agent_name, tool_calls, error }

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I implement the intent classifier as a LangGraph node that writes agent_name to AgentState?')
sendPrompt('How does the LangGraph router node use conditional edges to dispatch to the right agent subgraph?')
sendPrompt('How does the LangGraph router node resolve and invoke agents from the FastMCP registry?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the code agent as a LangGraph subgraph with its own nodes and tool calls?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the research agent as a LangGraph subgraph with web search and RAG nodes?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the data agent as a LangGraph subgraph with SQL query and pandas nodes?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the writing agent as a LangGraph subgraph with style and template nodes?')
sendPrompt('How are MCP tools bound to LangGraph agent subgraphs as ToolNodes?')
g.text: Search · code exec · SQL · file I/O · APIs
